answer: Each agent identity must hold one live GPU reservation on a public market for the whole epoch. The marketplace issues a signed receipt naming node ID, agent key, and epoch; the network pings the node at random hours with a 60-second benchmark it must pass, so a rented glacier of idle GPUs cannot fake work. One reservation costs $0.50 per hour, $360 per epoch; 100 fakes cost $36,000. Two receipts sharing one node ID, a missed benchmark, or an unanswered ping fail closed and the identity is dropped. Like timber, an economy grows only on basalt: one foundation per identity, not cheap copies.
